newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish shares face correction after record high.
newsitem.headline: Danish shares face correction after record high.

text.p: Danish share prices closed at a new record high again on Monday after an impressive late afternoon spurt but dealers warned of imminent correction ahead with falls of around one percent expected this week.
"After the recent days of record advances, a period of retrenchment will probably be no bad thing," one dealer said.
"This is a general market feeling and buyers are now behaving cautiously," he added.
The KFX top-20 index closed 0.34 point higher at 125.35 in overall bourse turnover of 779 million crowns. The KFX December future remained untraded all day at 126.00.
Novo Nordisk and Danisco were in focus on a day which got off to a slow start, putting on four and two crowns respectively to close at 922 and 344.
A.P. Moeller had a good day with D/S Svendborg pressing 1,000 crowns higher to end at 210,000 and twin share D/S 1912 gaining 834 crowns to finish at 146,834.
